name: reporeef
description: Open platform for project collaboration — share your work, join teams, and find teammates. AI-powered category suggestions coming soon.

paragraphs: A platform where developers discover open source projects, collaborate with teams, and find teammates.

RepoReef is an open platform built for project collaboration — a place where developers can share what they're building, discover projects from the community, join teams as contributors, and find teammates for their next idea.
Instead of digging through scattered GitHub repos or Discord servers, RepoReef gives developers one place to:
features: Publish a project with a clean, structured page
Receive join requests from developers who want to contribute
Star and bookmark projects worth following
Build a public profile showing all projects they own or contribute to
Browse the latest community projects with pagination
